{{Quote|My name is Da'la Socuna and I am here on behalf of the Rebel Alliance naval forces. I train pilots to fly and fight.|Da'la Socuna, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Da'la Socuna''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I would like to speak to the Rebellion trainer, Da'la.''"<br />"''I've heard rumors that she is in Mos Espa seeking pilots for some undisclosed mission.|A spacer and [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]]|<ref name="SWG:FtRApt">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Find the Rebel Alliance pilot trainer|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
Within the Alliance, Socuna attained the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and served with the [[Crimson Phoenix Squadron]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot trainer]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] she worked in the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While there, she recruited a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent to her by [[Gendra]]. She issued the novice pilot a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] and gave a mission to patrol a Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]] route in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. Though the pilot was ambushed by three [[TIE pilot]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]], they were all destroyed, and the pilot returned back safely.<ref name="SWG" />

Socuna later gave additional missions, which included hunting down [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], and escorting a crippled refugee [[Transport/Legends|transport]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. All missions were completed successfully, and Socuna awarded the pilot with a Rebel flightsuit. However, Socuna had one final task for her new pilot, which involved eliminated a TIE fighter Veteran Commander and his three escorts. Upon successful completion of the missions, Socuna transferred the pilot to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Eker]] for additional assignments.<ref name="SWG" />

She also became involved in the defense of Mos Espa when [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], led by the [[Tusken King]], launched an [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|invasion]] of the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="SWG:SwC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=heroic|Tusken Invasion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Da'la Socuna is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. She was added to the game with the [[2004]] expansion, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']].<ref name="SWG" />

In the game, Rebel players who join the Crimson Phoenix Squadron begin their training with Socuna.<ref name="SWG" />
